title: Shared Premium Distillery Tour in Orlando
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape to the Moonshine Distillery and Tasting Room at the Orlando Vineland Premium Outlets for a one-hour tropical adventure. Enjoy a guided tasting of SIX handcrafted moonshine flavors, then take an exclusive tour of your distillery. Bottle your own Moonshine!

Your Island Adventure Includes:
• Distillery tour and moonshine-making process
• Tasting flight of SIX tropical flavors
• Bottle your own Moonshine
• One handcrafted island cocktail
• Off retail and moonshine purchases
